topic: Basic Needs of People, Plants and Animals
key_concepts: People need food, water, air, and shelter to grow and stay alive.
Food gives energy and supports good health.
Water transports nutrients and removes waste from the body.
People inhale oxygen and exhale carbon dioxide.
Shelter protects people from danger, too much heat, and heavy rain.
Clothes protect the body from too much heat and cold.
Animals need food, water, air, shelter, and care to survive.
Plants need water, good soil, air, sunlight, and nutrients to grow.
Plants need care and protection from stray animals and extreme weather.
Cultivating soil and pulling weeds help keep plants healthy.
Living things include people, plants, and animals.
